From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Procurement readiness & mutual action plan - AcmeCloud

Thanks again for your time on the call today - great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement readiness and the commercial path.

Call recap:
- Use case: In-product summarization and search relevance for internal support articles (demo + perf targets reviewed)
- Expected baseline traffic: ~100k tokens/day initial, ramping to ~500k tokens/day over Q3
- Security & compliance: AcmeCloud requires security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence before procurement signs

Commercial path & asks:
- Preferred billing: PO (Net30) is our primary preference; we can accept card for pilot, but PO required for production commit.
- Marketplace: you mentioned interest in marketplace listing - we can support that, but marketplace procurement often adds time.
- Legal / SOW: Please confirm whether you need a formal SOW or a simple order form.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached): mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx - highlights:
- Legal review: target 1 week (owner: AcmeCloud legal)
- Security review: target 2 weeks (owner: AcmeCloud security)
- Finance approval / PO issuance: target 1 week after approvals (owner: AcmeCloud finance)
- Redwood readiness items: vendor packet & SOC2 paperwork (attached vendor_packet_redwood.zip)

Next steps:
1) Samantha: confirm preferred commercial path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and whether an SOW is required
2) If PO: confirm billing contact, billing address, and PO template we should expect
3) Camila: I recommend we schedule an initial security kickoff with your security reviewer this week - Camila will own that on our side

I attached the draft mutual action plan and vendor packet. Happy to adjust milestones - we want to make the path to PO issuance as predictable as possible.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
--
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), vendor_packet_redwood.zip (zip: SOC2 report, security overview)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecloud.com>

Cc: Victor Huang <vhuang@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & mutual action plan - AcmeCloud

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying questions: 

Procurement path:
- For production we prefer PO (Net30). We can put a card on file for the POC/pilot but will move to a PO once security and legal sign off.

Timeline (tentative from our side):
- Legal review (commercial terms/redlines): 5-7 business days after we get your standard contract
- Security review (questionnaire + evidence): 10-14 business days - security will run a questionnaire and ask for evidence; they may request a short kickoff call
- Finance / Procurement: 3-5 business days after approvals to cut PO

So a realistic calendar is ~3-4 weeks from contract submission to PO issuance, assuming no large legal terms to negotiate. That aligns with your MAP but wanted to be explicit.

Questions / requests:
1) Please send your standard terms sheet (Master Services Agreement or order form) - procurement@acmecloud.com will need it.
2) Please confirm Redwood's billing address and W-9 (for US vendor onboarding).
3) Security: who will be the Redwood point of contact for the questionnaire? We'll send the questionnaire to that person and they'll coordinate evidence collection.

We are open to marketplace in parallel, but procurement prefers a direct PO for predictability. 

Thanks - I'll coordinate legal and finance internally once we have the contract.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager | AcmeCloud
samantha.lee@acmecloud.com
--
